competencies.statement: The learner can apply basic interpersonal communication principles and describe an organization's basic structure and functions.
competencies.description: Communicates professionally and situates work within org structure.

competencies.statement: The learner can use common office tools to produce documents, spreadsheets, and presentations.
competencies.description: Produces a correct workplace document/spreadsheet/deck.

competencies.statement: The learner can prepare and deliver an oral presentation that clearly conveys information, concepts, and ideas.
competencies.description: Delivers a clear, structured spoken explanation.

competencies.statement: The learner can communicate with team members effectively and work collaboratively.
competencies.description: Coordinates and collaborates effectively on a team task.

competencies.statement: The learner can use a bug-tracking system to document and report defects.
competencies.description: Files a clear, reproducible, well-categorized defect.

competencies.statement: The learner can provide feedback and recommendations to developers on software usability and functionality.
competencies.description: Gives actionable usability/functionality feedback.

competencies.statement: The learner can collaborate with field staff or customers to diagnose problems and recommend solutions.
competencies.description: Diagnoses a reported problem and proposes a fix.

competencies.statement: The learner can monitor bug-resolution efforts and track outcomes.
competencies.description: Tracks defects through resolution and verifies closure.

competencies.statement: The learner can identify issues through close monitoring and report them clearly to senior team members.
competencies.description: Escalates an issue with the right clarity and detail.

competencies.statement: The learner can install and configure recreations of production environments to test software performance, under supervision.
competencies.description: Sets up a representative test environment.

competencies.statement: The learner can perform initial debugging by reviewing configuration files, logs, or code to locate a breakdown's source.
competencies.description: Uses logs/config/code to isolate a failure.

competencies.statement: The learner can install, maintain, and use software testing programs.
competencies.description: Operates test tooling correctly for a task.

competencies.statement: The learner can maintain automated test scripts to keep them current.
competencies.description: Updates a flaky/outdated automated test appropriately.

competencies.statement: The learner can help maintain a database of known test defects.
competencies.description: Records/organizes known defects for reuse.

competencies.statement: The learner can design or develop automated testing tools.
competencies.description: Builds a small test utility/automation.

competencies.statement: The learner can apply company-specific source-code management best practices.
competencies.description: Follows the team's version-control workflow.

competencies.statement: The learner can review software documentation for technical accuracy, compliance, and completeness to mitigate risks.
competencies.description: Reviews docs and flags gaps/risks.

competencies.statement: The learner can test system modifications to prepare for implementation.
competencies.description: Validates a change before release (regression/smoke).

competencies.statement: The learner can plan test schedules and strategies in accordance with project scope and delivery dates.
competencies.description: Builds a test plan that fits scope and timeline.

competencies.statement: The learner can contribute to implementing accessible and responsive website designs and applications.
competencies.description: Applies accessibility/responsiveness to a UI task.

competencies.statement: The learner can contribute to building the program using appropriate languages and development methods.
competencies.description: Implements a feature with suitable methods.

competencies.statement: The learner can participate in product design reviews, providing input on requirements, designs, schedules, or potential problems.
competencies.description: Gives useful review input that catches issues early.

competencies.statement: The learner can collaborate with cross-functional teams during design and implementation.
competencies.description: Works across roles to deliver a feature.
